def validate_amendment(config, native_root, own_index, captured, family_indices):
    assert config['helperAmendmentIndex'] == own_index
    own_data = read(own_index)
    assert own_data['sourceOnly'] is True and own_data['state'] == 'SEALED_SOURCE_ONLY_CRYPTO_OWNER355_GC_FREEZER_HELPER_AMENDMENT_V1'
    amendment_row = config['helperAmendmentAuthority']
    assert amendment_row != config['rootAuthority']
    value = read(amendment_row)
    validate_amendment_data(value, config, native_root, own_index)
    own_rows = family(own_index)
    peer = value['independentSourceReview']
    assert peer == native_root['externalControllerReview']
    peer_rows = family(peer['index'])
    assert peer['result'] in peer_rows
    validate_peer(read(peer['result']), own_index)
    captured += [amendment_row, *peer_rows]
    family_indices.append(peer['index'])
    # Every recorded preparation input is strict in its original context.
    freeze_row = next(r for r in own_rows if r['path'] == str(OWN / 'input-freeze.json'))
    inputs = read(freeze_row)['files']
    assert len({r['path'] for r in inputs}) == len(inputs)
    for row in inputs:
        checked(row)
        captured.append(row)

    assert value['activeFreezerEntry'] == native_root['helperAmendmentEntry']

    assert value['activeFreezerEntry'] in family(own_index)
    assert value['externalControllerEntry'] == native_root['externalControllerEntry']
    assert value['externalControllerIndex'] == own_index
    assert value['externalOutputRoot'] == str(OUT)
